About this tool

Created by

A clinician fills in this plan with the patient. It works best alongside self-management education and follow-up, not instead of them.

Default wording follows Canadian Thoracic Society and GOLD 2026 guidance, in plain language aimed at about a grade 6 reading level. Breathing skills follow those taught in Canadian pulmonary rehabilitation. The yellow-zone step approach was informed by Lung Foundation Australia's My COPD Action Plan; this tool is not endorsed by Lung Foundation Australia.

English is the source text. The other languages were reviewed line by line but are not certified: have a qualified medical translator check them before you give them to patients.

The edit code printed on each plan holds the same information as the printed page, so a PDF or photo of the plan can be re-opened here for editing. Nothing is uploaded; it is all read in your browser.

Use it offline or share it on a USB stick: download the single-file copy (.zip). Unzip it and double-click the .html file; no internet needed.
